description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class that encapsulates information about a recruitment attachment, including properties like id, filename, file type, size, related identity, and a comment. It provides constructor and getter methods for these properties.

classes.name: RecruitmentAttachment
classes.description: A PHP class representing a recruitment attachment with properties for id, filename, type, size, related identity, and comment, including constructor and getter methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of RecruitmentAttachment with provided property values.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: getFkIdentity
methods.description: Returns the foreign key identifier related to the attachment.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the attachment.
